Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India 



IS i 4035 -1967 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TROLLEYS, STRETCHER 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 7 August 1967, after the draft finalized by the Hospital Equipment 
Sectional Committee bad been approved by the Consumer Products 
Division Council. 

0.2 The formulation of Indian Standards on hospital equipment has been 
taken up on the recommendations of the Advisory Committee for the 
Develop merit of Surgical Instruments, Equipment and Appliances, 
Government of India. 

0.3 This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards on hospital 
furniture. Other standards published so far are: 

IS : 4036-1967 Specification for trolleys, patient's 

IS : 4037-1967 Specification for stretchers and stretcher carriers 

0.4 The dimensions of the stretcher trolleys have been specified keeping in 
view the interchangeability of stretchers made to internationally recom- 
mended standard dimensions. 

0.5 In preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from the 
following standards: 

ISO /R/ 168- 1960 (E) Stretcher, stretcher carriers and hospital 
trolleys (dimensions). International Organization for 
Standardization. 

IND/GS/MED 504 (c) Trolley, patients, complete. Chief Inspec- 
torate of General Stores, Ministry of Defence, Government of 
India. 

B.S. 2563 : 1955 Stretcher trolleys ( without top ) for indoor use in 
hospitals. British Standards Institution. 

0.6 In some of the clauses of the standard, reference has been made to 
IS : 4033* and IS : 4034 j* which are under preparation. Until these 
standards are published, the requirements in such clauses shall be subject 
to agreement between the concerned parties. 



♦General requirements for hospital furniture ( under preparation ). 
tSpecification for castors for hospital equipment ( under preparation ). 



ISt 4035- 1967 

0.7 This standard contains a clause which calls for agreement between 
the purchaser and the supplier. The relevant clause is 4.2. 

0.8 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS :2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies the requirements for stretcher trolleys 
( to support pole stretchers ) used in hospitals and at other similar places. 

2. MATERIALS 

2.1 Frame Work — shall be according to 2.1 of IS : 4033f. 

2.2 Hoops — shall be manufactured from mild steel strip conforming 
to IS : 1079-1963J. 

2.3 Castors — shall be according to IS : 4034§. 

3. DIMENSIONS 

3.1 The main dimensions of the trolley shall be as given in Fig. 1 . 

3.2 The thickness of the tubes used and their corresponding outside 
diameters for different parts of the trolley shall be as given below: 

Part Thickness of Tube Outside Diameter of Tube 

mm mm 

Vertical members 1*02 3175 

Horizontal members 1*02 25*40 

4. MANUFACTURE 

4.1 Trolley shall have a frame work of single continuous length mild steel 
tubes as shown in Fig. 1. The four upright members shall be connected 
together by two pairs of longitudinal tie bars and a pair each of transverse 
tie bars and curved hoops. The curved hoops shall be formed into 
brackets at the end to support the pole stretcher. For rest of the 
details, 4.1 of IS : 4033f shall apply. 

♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised). 
fGeneral requirements for hospital furniture ( undtr preparation ). 
{Specification for hot rolled carbon steel sheet and strip ( revised). 
{Specification for castors for hospital equipment ( under preparation ).

IS .4035- 1967 

4.2 Each trolley shall be provided with four castors having antistatic 
rubber tread. If so desired by the purchaser, the trolleys may be fitted 
with ordinary castors but in that case a brass earthing chain shall be 
attached to the trolley. For rest of the details, 4.2 of IS : 4033* shall apply. 

5. FINISH 

5.1 The finish shall be according to 5 of IS: 4033*. 

6. TESTS 

6.1 The tests shall be as specified in 6 of IS : 4033*. But when testing the 
performance under load, a total load of 135 kg shall be distributed over 
the full width of the trolley. 

7. MARKING 

7.1 The marking shall be in accordance with 7 of IS : 4033*. 

8. PACKING 

8.1 The packing shall be as specified in 8 of IS : 4033*.
